question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Mean
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' i.e. 'Greedy'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Mean"** can also be used to describe a person who is stingy or ungenerous.(कंजूस).

 
 
• **Example:** He is too mean to give a single penny to any charity.
 
 
 
• The word **"Greedy"** is used to describe an excessive or rapacious desire, especially for wealth or possessions. It is a close synonym to 'mean' in this context. (लालची)
 
 
• **Example:** She was greedy for power and fame.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"Unconscious"** refers to a state of lack of awareness, not conscious.(बेहोश).
 
• Option 3, **"Mode"** refers to a way or manner in which something occurs or is experienced, expressed, or done.(मोड़)
 
• Option 4, **"Wise**" means having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment.(बुद्धिमान)
